notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38602491/75564450b7808250ba5be8359e67794fe1cad384.png[/img]

Hi all! Been awhile since the last GWT patch but we've had a small influx of new players who have pointed out some pretty important bugs that needed fixing, so that's mostly what this is. The Alcove Prefex units missing from rescues *and* from caravan purchases was kind of a big deal - having them back in the game is going to make stuff a lot more interesting, especially in the campaign.

We also had a couple of handmade maps that either had a bug associated with them (like Bill Milton got a little too excited to be on Milton Highway, and he would appear even if you were playing as a different faction!) or just some balance issues.

Enjoy!

- Fixed a bug that caused Alcove Prefex units not to spawn as random units in several places in the game where they should've.
- Milton's Parkway map no longer has a weird Bill Milton on it
- Deleted Armand Peak map (sometimes games are better when you delete things from them!)

notes.title: Version 1.52
notes.notes:
Hey y'all! My desire with this game is to make sure that Rank 20 matches are hard enough that the people in my discord can't beat them (to create headroom) and to make sure that Rank 1 was easy enough that no one I can find is unable to beat those. This patch is yet another in that search. I improved the code a lot RE: how enemies are spawned so I think you should be seeing a lot more consistent results now. Also, omni-golems never did their job and they were kind of hacky anyway.

[b]ENJOY![/b]

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
Heads up! The hardest parts of this game just got harder. Ranks 15-20 now have more units per enemy spawn, and some Omni-Mob units have their stats changed a bit. Also though, the easiest ranks should be even *easier*! So you may have to mess around and pick a new difficulty to find the right one for you. Let us know where you seem to have a good, balanced battle!
- Omni-Golems removed from the game!
- Instead, after turn 12 the enemy reinforcements will start coming in every 2 turns instead of every 3 turns.
- Golden Reapers now have 9 attack, up from 7
- Omni Drill Sgts. now have 12 health, up from 10
- Lich Death Bolt damage 3=>4
- Fixed an Alcove Prefex bug with the sniper
- Summon Seedling now has a 2 turn cooldown. Take care of your seedlings!
- Seedlings and Fanatics (both player versions and summoned versions) attack damage 3=>2. It's good enough that your summons can absorb attacks, collect gems and rescue units!
- There were a couple of bugs with how enemies were spawning around castles before. The code for castle-guard-mobs has been changed so it's a lot more clear now, and works a lot more consistently. This means there's now ZERO castle guard-friends at rank 1, and SIX at rank 20.

notes.title: Version 1.43 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Version 1.43
This is another version that includes a LOT of polish, bug-fixing, and balancing. We've also reverted somewhat on a big change that was in 1.42, so heads up that Gem Power is BACK! Overall I've been playtesting a lot and really enjoying the game, but please come by the Discord or Steam Forums if you have any thoughts!

- Scorch has been a bit too harsh of a penalty to movement. Each turn, Scorch tiles have a 40% chance to turn back into grass.
- Reverted some of the recent changes to how abilities work: it now is a bit of a hybrid of the way the game has worked for a long time, and the new cooldown ideas. Gem Power is brought back: some abilities, most particularly your Wizard's, need Gem Power to cast. Most abilities do not have cooldowns, but a handful do.
- Gems no longer heal you.
- Summon Amp, Rocket Jump, Wildfire, Chill Step, and Siege Attack have 2 turn CDs.
- Returned to the normal pre 1.42 generation of Gems on a map
- Minor change to how fog works: once you reveal a unit, you permanently see them.
- Finally fixed a couple of issues with Castle Guards. They should wake up when pushed or bounced now.
- Fog of War vision radius increased from 3 => 4
- New fog artwork completely covers tiles.
- Reap now deals 0 damage to adjacent units unless there are 3 or more adjacent enemies, in which case it deals 2 damage to all adjacent enemies.
- Reap no longer reaps Deathberry Bushes.
- Splashmaster's Water Tank buffs brought back (and he lost his Aquatic buff!)
- Knight Charge no longer has a cooldown.
- Knight now needs CARROTS to do his Charge ability. Gain 1 Carrot for ending your turn on a grass tile.
- Roadie's PULL ability is now HEAVE: Bounce an adjacent unit backwards over your head 3 tiles.
- Roadie no longer has summon amp. Instead, SHE has the Amplify ability.
- Roadie AP 4=>3
- Roadie Attack 3=>2
- Amplify ONLY targets adjacent friendly units, and doesn't bump adjacent units.
- A system wide rule that didn't really matter until now: it used to be that secondary bounces would bounce the same amount as the original bounce. Now, secondary bounces are always 2.
- Siege Attack now creates Scorch on ALL tiles.
- Siege Attack base damage 3=>4
- Siege Attack splash damage was 1-2, now is 1-3
- Knight Charge now breaks enemy armor (-2 armor).
- In Ranked/Custom games you now start with 1 fewer unit (chosen at random). There are also 3 rescues (up from 1) and one of them is guaranteed to be your faction's missing unit.
- Skelly Archer's Aimed Shot now does 2/5 damage, up from 1/4. Also there's a sound now for the arrow hitting.
- Max range of the Omni Catapult is now 3 (down from 4)
- Enemies moving in fog now move quickly, and make a subtler sound.
- Omni Unit Health changes: Longbow 8 => 6, Lich 10 => 8, Royal Guard 10=>8
- The Farmer's "Rake" ability is removed; instead, he now has the Turtlepult's launch ability, renamed Toss.
- The Turtlepult is now "Snapping Turtle", has new art, and no longer has Launch.
- Band Together now gives the defensive bonus to both involved units.

notes.title: Version 1.36: NEW and IMPROVED rules for bumping, bug fixes and more!
notes.notes:
[b]Version 1.36[/b]
This version includes a pretty intense reworking, both code wise and rules wise of the BUMPING rules. They're something I've been working on and trying to get just right for awhile. Thanks to everyone in the Discord and the Steam forums for your help on this issue. Here's the new rules as listed in the Help screen: 
BUMPING is moving a unit forcefully. You can always BUMP a unit, unless there is a "SUPER HEAVY" (I'm going to rename this "immovable" later) unit behind them. If they move at least 1 full tile before hitting another unit, they'll deal damage based on how far they slid before they did. If units are adjacent to each other in a line, BUMPING one of the units bumps them all, in a chain.

Overall this version is a pretty big deal I think, especially for new players trying to understand how abilities are supposed to work.

PATCH NOTES:
- "Chain Bumping" removed! All bumps are now chainbumps.
- Fixed some bugs with splashmaster not putting as much water down as you'd expect.
- Fixed several bugs with Bill Milton's Develop.
- Omni Royal Guard HP 12 => 10
- Castle Guards are now hand picked for rank ranges. So at low levels castle guards will always be Fanatics, and at the highest level they'll always been Royal Guards.
- At higher ranks you'll see more enemies that are higher Level now.
- Enemies can't cast spells from the fog.

notes.title: Version 1.30 - new map types, new factions, massive rebalance, and more!
notes.notes:
[b]Version 1.30[/b]
It's been awhile, because this - as I always say - the biggest GWT patch yet. This is a massive overhaul of several systems in Gem Wizards Tactics. Actually, there *were* a lot of other changes that aren't listed here, some of which we reversed or partially reversed after testing them out. Overall, this is definitely the best version of Gem Wizards Tactics ever.

Gameplay in general now will be a bit more quick and to the point. Knowing when you'll have the AP to use your abilities just got WAY easier, because movement calculations are way simpler (all tile types cost 1 to move to, except river which costs 2). All abilities also cost 1 AP now. In general this should just "smooth out" the experience.

Probably the biggest change is the addition of the OMNI-MOB, a sort-of-new-faction of AI-only monsters. They're recolored versions of units like the Royal Guard, the Spudling, and several others, hand-picked to be "good as AI-controlled units". They also now are greatly simplified - no longer do they have all the same abilities as the player even though they could never know how to use Bulldoze or Chill Step properly - and have more specific amounts of health than before that helps me set up the challenge in a more fluid way.

Campaign Mode now has a BEAUTIFUL new background image created by @SmokedKun on Twitter - check it out: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38602491/6ef70bdb697bb8067f82f7dd3fe2d5cfe9efbd99.png[/img]

This also comes with a slew of changes to how Campaign Mode works. I think it's a lot clearer now what the objective is and how you win and lose missions.

But honestly, the biggest and most important thing, if you ask me, is about a dozen of these small specific unit changes that really just make the game better overall, balance wise, dynamics wise, etc.

Anyways, ENJOY!

[b]GAMEPLAY[/b]
- Map sizes reduced across the board.
- New map type, Ambush!, which has an objective to defeat all enemies and you start in the middle.
- You no longer face the player factions in battle. There is now just one AI faction called the Omni-Mob, who have adjusted health.
- Changed how treasure chests are spawned slightly.
- Abilities now cost 1AP across the board. Should make it easier to know when you'll have the AP to cast things.
- Almost all player units have a max AP of 3, with wizards having 4, and Omni-Mob units having 2.
- Forest no longer costs extra movement to move into. This also allows us to get rid of ".5" movement costs from the game.
- Mounted movement type removed entirely.
- Gems no longer heal your units.
- No units have less than 0 defense.

[b]SPECIFIC UNIT BALANCE[/b]
- Bikers now have 5 hp on the bike, and get 5 when off the bike (was 10/6).
- Biker Burn Rubber range decreased from 3 to 2
- Reaper pull range decreased from 4 to 3
- Roll Guards HP 10->15
- Roll Guards Defense 4->2
- Andromeda Storm GP cost 4->5
- Andromeda Storm damage 5->6
- Gelf Reckless Charge GP Cost 1->0
- Gelf Reckless Charge no longer deals 2 damage per mountain Gelf hits; instead he just always takes 2 damage from using the ability.
- Andromeda Summon Seedling can now be cast on occupied tiles to bounce the unit 2 tiles in that direction.
- Gelf and Knights have a new passive: Cavalry Charge. They do not deal out or get counter-attacks.

[b]CAMPAIGN MODE[/b]
- A small chance to get Ambushed as you attempt to start a mission.
- You now start each campaign with 100 Gold.
- All campaign difficulties will eventually reach Rank 20 if you dilly dally too much.
- You can now see unit max HP in the UI tooltips on the Faction Select screen.

[b]VISUAL[/b]

- Ice cubes no longer have a "bottom", allowing you to see the tile underneath

notes.title: Version 1.24
notes.notes:
This is actually a much "bigger" patch than it might seem like, because we iterated on a BUNCH of different rules over on the beta branch over the past week to try to fix some gameplay dynamics. Ultimately we landed on this scary guy: the OMNI GOLEM.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38602491/bf76865d23e4c3d9efb8901e6e89e9c1b0d3d198.png[/img]

Omni Golems are INVINCIBLE and UNBUMPABLE, and they spawn at the player's spawn point every 5 turns. The good news is, they're slow and they don't have a ranged attack. But if they do catch you, they do 7 damage and knock you back, so watch out.

In our playtesting, as long as you keep moving forward, you should be alright - it's just meant to combat the worst kind of turtling play.

There's also a huge change to towers: when you capture one, all of your units heal for 5. I'm feeling really good about this one! Check out the full notes below.

Oh, and next up... is a whole new faction! GET READY!!

[b]Version 1.24[/b]

- There is a new invincible OMNI-GOLEM monster that spawns from the player start every 5 turns in ranks 10+. As long as you keep moving, he shouldn't cause a problem.

notes.title: Version 1.20! The Caravan, and no more permadeath!
notes.notes:
[i][b]Gem Wizards Tactics no longer has "permadeath"![/b][/i]

I've always had issues with the term "permadeath", actually, because it's kind of unclear, it's kind of mixing mechanical and narrative (what is "death" exactly?)

Anyway, as we were experimenting with the new CARAVAN mode on the Beta Branch, one of our top GWT testers and all around awesomeguy, [url=https://twitter.com/ryanbowles42]Ryan Bowles[/url] (he's making his own cool turn based game which you should check out!) suggested, what if we just got rid of permadeath completely and made it that units were just benched for 1 mission if they were killed?

At first I was kinda unsure about that. I mean, isn't the whole premise with a mode like this, that X-Com style "gaining and losing guys" economy? But at the same time, for a long time I had been bugged by the fact that gameplay in Ranked Mode was strategically very different from that in Campaign Mode. In Ranked Mode, it's perfectly reasonable to make sacrifice plays, where you lose a unit to achieve some objective. In Campaign Mode, you couldn't do that nearly as much.

Then, when we added the "hit points are saved between missions" in the first Beta version of the Caravan, another playtester Reschiiiv noticed that now the game had become extremely calculationy and intense. Every single hit point mattered now. Maybe that's not super good for a game that is trying to be [url=http://keithburgun.net/how-to-add-strategy-to-your-tactics-game/]more strategic and less tactical[/url].

So, with all this in mind, and with Ryan's awesome suggestion, I decided to go completely the other way and get rid of Permadeath completely. Now, when a unit dies in battle, it's simply benched for 1 mission. (Your Wizard is still exempt from this, of course). There's no saving of hit points at all.

There will probably need to be other balance changes going forward; if anything, the game should be a bit easier now than it was before, at all levels. So I'm looking forward to your thoughts.

Without any further adieu, here are the patch notes - which also have many, many other significant changes! Check it out!

notes.title: Version 1.06
notes.notes:
This is a really exciting one! We've been getting a lot of feedback about the game and hopefully this shows that we're taking it to heart. Now only do we have the new difficulty modes in Campaign Mode now, but in Unranked Play you can actually modify the rate at which new squads spawn in (or even turn it off completely!). This should give more players the ability to play the game how they want.

What I'm personally most excited about is the Icon-flags system. I really think it's a big bump in how strategic (as opposed to tactical) the game is, and that's exciting.

Also: BEWARE! The AI is a lot smarter now. Well, not really - it's more just that they were unnecessarily ending their turn after using a spell before. Now, they don't!

There's a ton of other cool stuff in here, polish, balance, bugfixing and pretty much everything else you could imagine. I'm really excited, maybe I'll do some streaming myself tomorrow. Come on by! (www.twitch.tv/keithburgun).

(Also this should be working properly now) - Bill Milton loans $15=>$20 - 16:10 resolutions should be supported now! - More bugs fixed • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • Version 0.237 PATCH NOTES • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • - Gem spawn % reduced from .4 to .15 for maps, and constrained the part of the level where they can appear a bit - Difficulty increase from squad to squad is now more gradual. - More feedback for gaining gems - Self preservation damage 2=>3 - Self preservation AP cost 1=>2 - Chill Step range 4=>3 - Fixed a bunch of bugs with squad spawns - New flames rules - they should only be damaging each unit once per turn. • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • Version 0.236A PATCH NOTES • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • - Flanking now disables counter-attacking instead of -1 Defense. - There are now 6 tutorial levels, with some more speaking characters - Can now build a Bunnker anywhere. - Ice mage attack 4 => 2 - Improved tooltips - NEW FEATURE: Gem Messages. There are 51 Gem Messages that can be collected and viewer - On-hit effects shouldn't be happening for counter-attackers who can't counter-attack - Fixed bug with enemy spawns at high rank - Flames no longer hurt you when created, they hurt once per turn • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • Version 0.235 PATCH NOTES • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • - Flames now scorch upon being made - Fire Mages now have Melt Armor - reduce an enemy's armor by 1 and make them vulnerable to fire (+2 damage) for 1 turn. Costs 0 GP. - Campaign Mode: Losing your wizard now increases Enemy Power by 8. - Catapult siege attack is now just 2 AP (was a bug that it was 3, jeez louise) - Pyro Flame Attack now creates flames on the attack tile and the 1 tile behind it, usually resulting in 2 damage instantly (and turning their tile into Scorch of course). - Pyro ATTACK 4=>3 - Royal Guard Defense 3=>2 - Royal Guard Block ability doesn't work in water - Reckless Charge GP cost 3=>1 - Fireball cost 3=>2 - Fixed several bugs

notes.title: Patch Notes v. 234
notes.notes: • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • Version 0.234 PATCH NOTES • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • • - New message log window, which is accessible by clicking on the normal message log. - More improvements to movement indicator, which now shows your max AP as well as your current. - Summoned units now check the tile that they're on - fixed some descriptions for units - Chill Step now creates floe on origin tile - Ranged Attack now costs 1AP - In Campaign Mode, levelups say "+1 ATK" or "+1 DEF" instead of just level up - Reduced Flag Goals for several mission types from 5 to 4 or 4 to 3. - For ranks 1-5, flag goal is capped at 3. - Now the first time you deal 1 damage, the game will give you a popup telling you "use abilities and flank!" - Fixed many bugs with the combat preview

notes.title: Version .227
notes.notes:
Post release I'll start posting every patches notes here on Steam. For now though I'm just doing the larger beta ones up here. You can read the full patch notes in the app itself.

- HUGE CHANGE: Damage range is now -1 to +1 of base.
- retreat damage cap set 5=>6
- Minimum damage is now 1 for real
- Edge Scroll settings now save CORRECTLY!
- A few units damage/armor tweaked
- All factions now start with 7 units total, and their whole faction is represented.
- The game now generates way more Liberation % per mission overall.
- The enemy power now grows faster as well
- You are now guaranteed on each campaign hub set of missions to get a max of 7 rescuable units and a minimum of 2.
- Flames should not double up on 1 tile
- Flames should remove other appropriate terrain effects
- Tweaked Ice Mage abilities to make a bit more sense
- Reaper Hook no longer stuns, and shouldnt be able to grab through mountains
- Checks for wins on enemy turn
